description_en: Activates a router interface that is in the Inactive state
description_zh: 调用ActivateRouterInterface接口激活处于Inactive状态的路由器接口
kebab_example: aliyun vpc activate-router-interface --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --router-interface-id ri-2zeo3xzyf38r4urz0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ActivateRouterInterface

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the router interface.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query region IDs
parameters.help_zh:
路由器接口所在的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID。
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the router interface. 
The ID of the router interface. This operation supports only interfaces in the Inactive state. If the state does not match, the IncorrectRIStatus error is returned. Newly created interfaces are not in the Inactive state and cannot be directly activated: interfaces created in express connect mode are automatically connected and in the Active state. You must first call DeactivateRouterInterface to change them to the Inactive state. Interfaces created in non-express connect mode are in the Idle state. You must first configure peer information and call ConnectRouterInterface to establish the connection to the Active state, and then call DeactivateRouterInterface. State transition: Active --DeactivateRouterInterface--> Inactive --ActivateRouterInterface--> Active. If the interface is in an intermediate state such as Connecting, Activating, or Deactivating, poll DescribeRouterInterfaceAttribute until the state stabilizes
parameters.help_zh:
路由器接口ID。 
路由器接口ID。本API仅支持 Inactive 状态的接口，状态不符返回 IncorrectRIStatus。新建接口均不处于 Inactive，不能直接激活：快速连接模式创建的接口已自动建连为 Active，须先调用 DeactivateRouterInterface 置为 Inactive；非快速连接创建的接口为 Idle，须先配置对端信息并调用 ConnectRouterInterface 建连至 Active，再 DeactivateRouterInterface。状态流转：Active --DeactivateRouterInterface--> Inactive --ActivateRouterInterface--> Active。若处于 Connecting/Activating/Deactivating 等中间态，请轮询 DescribeRouterInterfaceAttribute 直至状态稳定
parameters.name: router_interface_id
